description: Implement tvOS focus engine and iOS navigation patterns. For tvOS: implement custom focus behavior with preferredFocusEnvironments, focus animations, focus guides, tab bar navigation with Siri Remote. For iOS: NavigationStack/NavigationSplitView for iPhone/iPad, tab bar navigation, modal presentations, deep linking support. Ensure proper focus restoration and navigation state management.
title: Phase 3.10: iOS/tvOS Focus Engine & Navigation
